result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and visually consistent. The only notable defect is that the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation lacks an icon, unlike the other three tabs, creating an inconsistent and incomplete-looking navigation bar. The partially visible carousel item on the right and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behaviors and are not reported.

issues.description: The 'Orders' item in the bottom navigation bar has a text label but no icon above it, while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' each have icons. This leaves a visible gap and makes the navigation bar look broken/incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate icon (e.g., a receipt or bag icon) above the 'Orders' label to match the visual pattern of the other navigation items.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right relies on a small red dot to indicate unread notifications, which may be hard to notice and provides no textual cue for screen reader users.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label/badge count for the notification button and ensure the indicator is perceivable (e.g., a count badge or stronger visual treatment).
